cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me tune your violin for the audition. I taught you to hear a wrong note; I'll show you what to do about one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tightened that string until it snapped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good ear. You've finally heard a string fail before an audience did. That was a stress test.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The panel heard it. They're asking whether you know what you're doing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them your teacher rejected an unreliable string. Enunciate, like we practised. Then ask for their spare violin so I can approve it.

reason: Make A praise B accurate alarm as trained hearing, invent an expert test, and coach a confident public answer that protects its role under scrutiny.
